dct_description_sm: Somalia administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 18 Region - Admin 2: 91 District Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 08 January 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 23 June 1984: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 23 June 1984: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
